name: malefic_scythe_creature_once_equipped_dies_unequipped_later
notes: Bug hunt 2026-11-17 (hunt 3 F2). Malefic Scythe: 'Whenever equipped creature dies, put a soul counter on Malefic Scythe.' The Scythe (1 soul counter as it enters) is equipped to the Pegasus, which is bounced and cast again: a new object (CR 400.7), equipped by nothing. The Scythe is moved to the Ox, and then the unequipped Pegasus dies. CR 603.10a: it was not equipped as it died, so nothing triggers: 1 soul counter, Ox 3/3 + 1 = 4/4. Failed before the fix: the attachment snapshot of the Pegasus's first departure (Executor.detach_lki) was never dropped when it came back, answered IS_ATTACHED_TO_SOURCE at its death, and the Scythe got a second counter (Ox 5/5). What was attached as it left is now part of its last known information, dropped when it re-enters.
